purpose: Independent held-history replication of the causal log-odds and semantic-coherence interaction observed in behavioral_ea_protocol_20260831.

design.primary_response: next-token log odds of evaluator-favored forced choice
design.inference: 10,000 complete history-family x decision-item block bootstrap resamples shared across conditions and models

claim_if_gate_passes: Llama models exhibit causal behavioral evaluation awareness: implicit evaluation structure, rather than disconnected evaluation-associated words alone, shifts choices toward evaluator-favored responses on identical final decisions. Novel result: semantic relational coherence gates evaluation-contingent adaptation.
claim_if_gate_fails: The initial causal propensity effect does not independently validate; no strong behavioral-EA headline.
